item.title: Barnette's Conjecture Solution Discussed on Hacker News
item.description:
Barnette’s Conjecture Solution Discussed on Hacker News

On 7 October 2026, a Hacker News comment highlighted a claimed proof of Barnette’s Conjecture (Problem 180) and sparked a mix of emotional reactions.

🔍 Overview

  • Date: 7th October 2026
  • Topic: Barnette’s Conjecture, Problem 180
  • Commenter: Jake Boggan (Hacker News comment on openai/math)

💭 Community Reaction

  • “I spent thousands of hours on that problem.”
  • “I really enjoyed it.”
  • “But it’s supposedly proven here – problem 180.”
  • “I don’t know what to think exactly.”
  • “Hearing that it is solved somehow makes me sad in a far‑off way, like hearing an ex‑girlfriend died suddenly in a car crash.”
  • “I don’t know, there’s probably a lot of people feeling odd emotions tonight.”
